notes: The shared observer already marks failed/expired before the apply phase as refused. The deletion saga now ends that observation in conflict and settles the control failed exactly once.
A mid-apply failure (phase staging) stays reconciling and is not resent.

Preflight runs before the first deletion frame and before the tombstone commit. Resume of an already-authorized queued deletion does not call the provider again: the crash worker treats that call as unexpected, and post-send SIGKILL remains one frame.

An organic post-send deletion refusal could not be induced on ef6a774 without B3b. CLI remember after accept raises TOMBSTONE_SET_STALE; mutating the sealed generation raises GENERATION_SPLIT_BRAIN. The real-provider test therefore writes the same failed/claimed journal state the provider records and observes it through the real status call. The read-wedge itself was not worked around.
